title: Quality and Dissemination of Uterine Fibroid Health Information on TikTok and Bilibili: Cross-Sectional Study
screen_reason: QUALITY-ONLY study, the case §1 excludes and §3 defines. The 200 videos (100 TikTok, 100 Bilibili) were scored only on the Global Quality Score (1-5), a modified DISCERN reliability checklist (0-5), PEMAT understandability/actionability, and a 0-14 content-completeness score. No video is ever judged true or false against any external ground truth, and no share of videos is reported as inaccurate, misleading or misinformation — the words 'misinformation' and 'misleading' appear only in the framing and recommendations, never as a coded outcome. All results are MEDIANS on scales (GQS median 3, mDISCERN median 2), which §1 also excludes ('scale MEANS only, with no share of respondents/items'). A wholly accurate video can score low on all four instruments (for lacking cited sources, balance, or actionable steps), which is exactly the §3 test that sends an instrument to QUALITY rather than CONTENT. Values recorded below in case an adjudicator wants a QUALITY row with value_kind scale_score.
missed_or_uncertain: Everything the paper reports, verbatim, so an adjudicator can build a QUALITY row without re-reading it. Corpus: 'A total of 200 uterine fibroid-related videos (100 from TikTok and 100 from Bilibili) were selected through a keyword search' using the Chinese keyword 子宫肌瘤, top 100 comprehensively ranked videos per platform, collected 3-7 March 2025 from newly registered accounts; China; Chinese-language only; inclusion 20 s to 15 min. QUALITY scores (Table 1, medians with IQR): GQS TikTok 3 (3-4), Bilibili 3 (2-4), P=.62; mDISCERN TikTok 2 (2-2), Bilibili 2 (2-2), P=.18; PEMAT-U TikTok 77% (69-83), Bilibili 77% (69-85), P=.47; PEMAT-A TikTok 67% (33-67), Bilibili 67% (0-67), P=.77. Interrater Cohen kappa 0.727 (GQS) and 0.725 (mDISCERN), two trained gynaecological experts. NOTE for anyone tempted to treat PEMAT percentages as prevalences: they are checklist scores per video (percentage of applicable PEMAT items met), not a share of videos. Content COVERAGE percentages (completeness coding, 7 domains scored 0-2): treatment discussed in 70% (140/200) of videos (123/200, 61.5% partial and 17/200, 8.5% complete), symptoms in 49% (98/200), etiology and diagnosis 30.5% vs 32%, epidemiology only 12% (12/100) of TikTok videos (11/100 partial, 1/100 full), and 'no videos provided a detailed explanation of prevention strategies'. These are topic-coverage shares, not falsity shares, so they support no prevalence row. Source distributions are reported inconsistently and should not be used without checking the source data: Table 2 gives TikTok nonprofessional individuals 1, professional individuals 83, professional institutions 16, while the text says 'nonprofessional individuals (16/100, 16%) and professional institutions (1/100, 1%)'; for Bilibili, Table 2 gives professional institutions 39 and nonprofessional individuals 6, while the text says 'non-professional individuals comprised 39% (39/100)'. Engagement medians (TikTok likes 431, comments 35, collections 129, shares 72, followers 115,000; Bilibili 44, 4, 30, 14, 14,000) are dissemination metrics with no veracity component.

rob.design: Cross-sectional quality appraisal of a rank-truncated video sample. Two new accounts were registered on Douyin/TikTok and Bilibili (3-7 March 2025) and the top 100 comprehensively ranked videos per platform for the keyword 子宫肌瘤 (uterine fibroids) were screened against inclusion criteria (Chinese language, 20 s - 15 min, on-topic, verified uploader identity), giving 200 videos. Two trained gynaecological experts scored every video with GQS, modified DISCERN and PEMAT-A/V; interrater Cohen kappa 0.727 and 0.725 ('substantial'). Analysis by Mann-Whitney U, Spearman correlation and stepwise regression in SPSS 27. No human participants, no response rate. Authors' own stated limitations: Chinese-language only, top-100 selection subject to platform algorithmic bias and therefore possibly unrepresentative of all uterine fibroid content, the appropriateness of GQS/mDISCERN for video 'demands further confirmation', and very few videos from institutional sources. Denominator would be denom_scope topical with denom_selection curated (rank-truncated top-100 sets) if a row were ever created.
rob.item6_quote: The videos were evaluated by 2 trained gynecological experts using the Global Quality Score (GQS) and a modified DISCERN (mDISCERN) tool. In addition, the Patient Education Materials Assessment Tool for Audio and Visual Materials was used to assess the understandability and actionability of the videos.
rob.item10_quote: The videos on both platforms demonstrated suboptimal overall quality and reliability, reflected by median GQS score of 3 (IQR 3-4) for TikTok and the median GQS score of Bilibili is 3 (IQR 2-4). The median modified DISCERN scores were also low: 2 (IQR 2‐2) for TikTok and 2 (IQR 2‐2) for Bilibili, with no significant differences between the 2 platforms (P=.62 for GQS; P=.18 for mDISCERN).
